name: Crystal Phial
summary: In Shadowglen, Tenaron Stormgrip entrusts young night elves with a Crystal Phial. They carry it to a nearby moonwell to draw sacred water for rites honoring and nourishing Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Vessel for Sacred Waters
sections.body: Young night elves receive a Crystal Phial atop Aldrassil. Tenaron Stormgrip sends them to the moonwell just north of the bough to gather its glowing waters. The delicate vessel holds water touched by the sacred legacy of the Well of Eternity. Returning with a Filled Crystal Phial begins the Crown of the Earth pilgrimage, teaching the young kaldorei about the balance of magic, history, and nature in their new island home.

faq.q: What is the Crystal Phial used for?
aliases: what do i do with the phial
faq.answer: The Crystal Phial gathers blessed water from the moonwell just north of Aldrassil in Shadowglen. You return the filled phial to Tenaron Stormgrip for the Crown of the Earth pilgrimage.

faq.q: Who gives you the Crystal Phial?
faq.answer: Druid Tenaron Stormgrip gives you the empty Crystal Phial atop Aldrassil.

faq.q: Why is gathering moonwell water significant?
faq.answer: Moonwell water is tied to the Well of Eternity and the grace of Elune. Gathering it helps you learn about the aftermath of the Third War and take part in rites to nourish Teldrassil.

faq.q: What happens after the phial is filled?
faq.answer: Once filled, the vessel becomes a Filled Crystal Phial. You return it to Tenaron Stormgrip, completing your first trial and opening further lessons about creating and caring for the World Tree across Teldrassil.

angles.text: As a young kaldorei, filling this phial is a first rite of passage beyond Aldrassil. It connects you to the waters of Elune and your people's recovery after the Third War.
As a druid, you hold moonwells in deep reverence. Their serene waters help you channel natural energies and nurture new growth without giving in to arcane sorcery.
